projection.name: mqtt
projection.title: MQTT
projection.description: MQTT broker client with live subscriptions, publishing, retained-message browsing, a topic tree, $SYS metrics, and EMQX management tables.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.help: Must be unique on the broker; a duplicate ID disconnects the other client. Left at the default, each session gets its own suffix.

fields.label: Observe topics
fields.help: Keeps a background subscription so the topic tree, retained snapshot, and recent messages have data.

fields.label: Topic limit
fields.help: Maximum distinct topics held in the observation cache.

fields.label: EMQX dashboard URL
fields.help: Optional. Enables the clients, subscriptions, and node tables; plain brokers can leave this empty.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks publish, retained-message removal, and client kicks.

fields.label: Topic
fields.help: Required unless publishing from a topic view, which supplies the selected topic.

fields.label: Retain
fields.help: The broker keeps this payload and replays it to every new subscriber of the topic.

actions.label: Rescan retained
actions.confirmText: Drop the observation cache and re-subscribe so the broker replays its retained messages?

actions.label: Clear retained
actions.confirmText: Remove the retained message from the broker? Subscribers will no longer receive it on connect.

actions.label: Clear buffer
actions.confirmText: Discard the buffered messages held for this connection?

actions.label: Kick
actions.confirmText: Disconnect this client from the broker?
